name: @anotoki/lib
description: What the anotoki sites share, the Angular half: the family's styles (@anotoki/lib/styles), UI kit (@anotoki/lib/ui and its entry points), top bar and frame (@anotoki/lib/shell), the migrations module (@anotoki/lib/migrations, @anotoki/lib/migrations/page), the translations module (@anotoki/lib/translations, @anotoki/lib/translations/admin, @anotoki/lib/translations/testing) signing in through the anotoki IAM (@anotoki/lib/auth, @anotoki/lib/auth/testing: the sign-in hint, the guards, the account's preferences, the sign-in failure's screen), the administrators' People page (@anotoki/lib/people, @anotoki/lib/people/page), the browser's errors in the site's error log (@anotoki/lib/error-report), the legal pages - Terms, Privacy, Contact - and the footer's links to them (@anotoki/lib/legal, @anotoki/lib/legal/pages) and the library's own words (@anotoki/lib/words, @anotoki/lib/words/<namespace>). The PHP half is the Composer package anotoki/lib.
